Advantages.title: A dental visit you won't dread
Advantages.subtitle: We know a lot of people feel anxious about the dentist. Everything here is designed to keep you comfortable and in the loop.

painless.title: Gentle numbing
painless.text: A numbing gel before every injection and modern anesthetics. Most patients feel nothing more than light pressure.

equipment.title: Modern technology
equipment.text: 3D cone-beam imaging, a dental microscope and digital scanners mean more accurate diagnoses and gentler treatment.

warranty.title: Up to {years}-year warranty
warranty.text: Written coverage on implants, crowns and veneers, with the terms laid out before you start.

installments.title: Interest-free payment plans
installments.text: Spread treatment over $500 across up to 12 months. We're also in network with most PPO plans.

kids.title: Pediatric dentist
kids.text: A playful first meeting and short visits, so kids grow up without a fear of the dentist.

everyday.title: Open 7 days a week
everyday.text: Evening hours until 8 PM and weekend appointments make it easy to fit a visit into your schedule.

Doctors.title: Meet your dentists
Doctors.subtitle: Each of our dentists keeps up with ongoing training and stays with you from first consultation to final result.

Process.title: Four simple steps
Process.subtitle: No surprises. You'll know what happens at each stage and what it costs before we begin.

request.title: Request a visit
request.text: Send a quick request online or give us a call — it takes less than a minute.

call.title: We call you back
call.text: Our front desk calls within 15 minutes during office hours to find a time and dentist that suit you.

consultation.title: Exam and plan
consultation.text: Your dentist examines you, takes any needed imaging, and gives you a written plan with exact prices.

treatment.title: Treatment
treatment.text: We follow the plan you agreed to, then see you for routine checkups to keep things healthy.

Offer.title: Free consultation and 3D scan
Offer.text: A full exam, 3D imaging and a written treatment plan with prices — at no cost. Then decide when and how to move forward, no pressure.
Offer.note: Normally from $60 for the exam and $150 for the 3D scan

Contacts.title: Visit us
Contacts.subtitle: We're in downtown San Francisco, a five-minute walk from Civic Center station.

Footer.tagline: A family dental practice in San Francisco. Gentle treatment, plain explanations, and results we stand behind.

Privacy.metaDescription: How BrightSmile Dental collects, uses and protects the information you share on our website.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: We take your privacy seriously. This page explains, in plain language, what information we receive through our website, why we need it, and the choices you have.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: This website belongs to BrightSmile Dental, 1250 Market Street, San Francisco, CA 94102, USA. For any privacy questions, email {email} or call {phone}.

sections.title: What we collect
paragraphs: Only what you enter in the booking form: your name, phone number and, if you choose, a service, a dentist, a preferred date and time, and a comment.
We don't ask for or store medical records, payment details or insurance ID numbers through this website. Please don't include that kind of information in the comment field.

sections.title: How we use it
paragraphs: To call you back, answer your questions and schedule your visit. We don't use your details for marketing emails, and we never sell them.

sections.title: Where it's stored and who sees it
paragraphs: Your request goes to a private Telegram chat used by our front desk team. The website has no database. Only staff who handle scheduling can see booking requests.

The website is hosted on Vercel, and Telegram delivers booking requests. These services process data only as needed to run. We don't share your information with anyone else unless the law requires it.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Booking requests are kept for up to 12 months and then deleted from the team chat. If you become our patient, your records are kept as required by law.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: We don't use advertising cookies or web analytics. The Contact section includes an embedded Google Map; when it loads, Google may set its own cookies under Google's privacy policy.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask what information we hold about you, have it corrected or deleted, or withdraw your consent at any time. Just email {email} and we'll respond within 30 days.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: Only a parent or legal guardian can book a visit for a child. We don't knowingly accept requests from children under 13.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If we update this policy, the new version will be posted on this page with a new date.
